dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where's the treasure, huh? You sure you're not cheating us?

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: No, no, I would never do that! Now, your man Old Chou here's not a man of fancy birth, no sir, but I can at least claim to be an honorable person!

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: You know what? C'mere, let me give you a hint for all your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: So, get this... the best stuff is always surrounded by the most explosives. For example, the four tiles around a treasure chest will all contain explosives!

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: Only two of the tiles around ore will contain those explosives, and the tiles that surround a tile with no treasure at all will most certainly be free of any danger.

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: So what I'm saying is, don't be too discouraged if you dig up a couple of explosives. There's light at the end of the tunnel — you'll see!
